item.title: Clear previews for more Murph links
item.summary: Referral invites, device connect nudges, and group sponsorship links now unfurl with dedicated cards instead of the generic homepage preview.
item.details: Biomarker research, experiment research and results, and checkout pages also show their own cards again. Previews stay generic on purpose: they are fetched without your login, so they never include your data or promise anything a link can no longer deliver.
